title: Rabbi Tanchum bar Maryon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot, chapter 1, halakhah 2, speaking in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. In Bereshit Rabbah 22:6 he relates: “There are dogs in Rome that know how to scheme,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: Both consulted passages expressly name Rabbi Tanchum bar Maryon. The Bereshit Rabbah story illustrates dogs feigning sleep to steal bread, supporting the sense “know how to scheme”; its further narrative is not added to the entry.
